vaulting.title: Vaulting
vaulting.descriptionText: Vaulting a PayPal account will allow you to charge the account in the future without requiring your customer to be present during the transaction or re-authenticate with PayPal when they are present during the transaction.

express.title: Express Checkout Shortcut
express.subtitle: Express Checkouts increase the conversion rate in your shop and pose no financial risk to you as a merchant. It is recommended to keep them activated.
express.alertMessage: Double opt-in for guests is activated in one of your Sales Channels. This feature is not compatible with PayPal Express Shortcut buttons. Customers who sign up via the Express Checkout Shortcut buttons won't receive double opt-in verification emails.
express.alertMessagePhone: Phone numbers are required for one of your Sales Channels. Please ensure that you have enabled the transmission for "contact phone number" in the PayPal account settings to avoid checkout issues. You can find this setting {url}.
express.ecsShippingCallbackSettingDisabledToolti: The shipping callback can not be enabled as "Local development environment" is active

installment.title: 'Pay Later' banner
installment.subtitle: Banners increase the conversion rate in your shop and pose no financial risk to you as a merchant. It is recommended to keep them activated.
installment.previewNoCredentials: Enter your PayPal credentials to see the banner preview.
installment.previewSdkError: Could not initialize the PayPal SDK. Please verify your client ID.
installment.previewNoOffers: No Pay Later offers are available for your account with the current settings.
installment.pageVisibilitySubtitle: The banner will be displayed on the following pages.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.info: The webhook is used for updating the status of a transaction asynchronously. Incorrectly registered webhooks, e.g. on a different or not publicly available server, may result in unconfirmed transactions, regardless whether the transaction has been processed by PayPal.
webhook.tooltipDisabled: Webhook can not be refreshed as "Local development environment" is active

honey.info: The webhook is used for registration. It transmits all the data required to activate and use the sales channel.

crossBorder.title: Pay Later cross-border messaging
crossBorder.warning: Please contact your PayPal representative to enable this feature for your account.
crossBorder.info: Pay Later messaging is a feature that allows you to display a Pay Later message in the language of the customer. This feature is only available for certain countries. {0}

environment.title: Environment
environment.info:
PayPal will send order status updates to the shop via webhooks, and will also request cart recalculations when customers make changes in the PayPal Express Checkout UI. If the shop is not publicly accessible (e.g. if it is in a development/staging environment, or if it requires authentication), you can mark this instance as a "local environment" to prevent connection errors.
Please note that any webhook listener will be deregistered when saving.

sdk.title: PayPal SDK version 6
sdk.info:
This will activate the latest version of the PayPal checkout integration, PayPal SDK v6. Version 6 offers improved performance and security, as well as better compatibility with modern payment workflows. Please note that some customisations and extensions may require adaptation.
SDK v6 will become the default implementation in version 11 of this plugin.
sdk.recommendation: We highly recommend enabling this option to take advantage of the latest features and improvements.
sdk.bannerText: Enable the latest PayPal SDK v6 for improved performance and security in your shop.
sdk.ineligible: The PayPal SDK v6 is not activated for your PayPal account yet. You can activate it in your PayPal merchant account.
sdk.undetermined: Could not determine whether the PayPal SDK v6 is activated for your PayPal account. Please make sure that your API credentials are valid and that PayPal can be reached.

expressCallback.title: Express Checkout callback
expressCallback.subtitle: PayPal calls this shop to update the shipping costs when a buyer changes the shipping method in the PayPal dialog.
expressCallback.selectSalesChannel: Select a Sales Channel to check its callback.

inactive.title: Express Checkout isn't active
inactive.summary: PayPal or its Express Checkout buttons are off in this Sales Channel, so PayPal doesn't call it.

local_environment.title: Local development environment is on
local_environment.summary: PayPal doesn't call this shop. Turn it off in the {advancedTab} of a live shop.

disabled.title: "Shipping method choice in PayPal dialog" is off
disabled.summary: Buyers can't change the shipping method in PayPal, so PayPal doesn't call this shop. You can turn it on in the {storefrontTab}.

outcome.answered: The shop sent the recalculated prices.
outcome.rejected: The shop declined the buyer's address or shipping method. That's expected if your shipping methods exclude it.

noCallback.title: No callback received yet
noCallback.description: To try it, start an Express Checkout in your storefront, change the shipping method in the PayPal dialog, then check again. Callbacks from before the update to this version aren't recorded.
noCallback.summary: PayPal only calls when a buyer changes the shipping method in its dialog.

last_callback_failed.title: Last callback failed
last_callback_failed.summary: The shop answered with a server error on {date}. The log below has the details.

untrusted_proxy.title: HTTPS proxy isn't trusted
untrusted_proxy.description: This request came through an HTTPS proxy that Shopware doesn't trust, and PayPal doesn't follow the redirect to HTTPS. If the storefront runs behind the same proxy, add it to TRUSTED_PROXIES.
untrusted_proxy.summary: Callback URLs start with http://, so PayPal's calls end at the redirect to HTTPS.

sandbox.title: Sandbox is active
sandbox.summary: PayPal's sandbox is unreliable with callbacks. If Express Checkout fails, try live credentials.

store_api_url_unknown.title: Callback URL not known yet
store_api_url_unknown.summary: The shop learns it with the first Express Checkout through the Store API.

store_api_host_unknown.title: Callback URL on an unknown host
store_api_host_unknown.summary: The Store API is called on {host}, which isn't a domain of this shop, so it isn't tested. Add {host} as a domain of a Sales Channel to test it.

webhook.title: Webhooks
webhook.subtitle: PayPal tells this shop about payment changes, for example completed captures or refunds.
webhook.selectSalesChannel: Select a Sales Channel to check its webhook.

missing.title: Test webhook didn't arrive
missing.description: PayPal sent a test webhook to the registered URL, but it didn't arrive within a minute. PayPal only sends test webhooks to HTTPS URLs on port 443, and the shop rejects webhooks with an outdated token. The reachability test below shows whether the URL answers.
missing.descriptionCandidate: PayPal sent a test webhook to this URL, but it didn't arrive within a minute. If you register it, webhooks won't arrive there either. PayPal only sends webhooks to HTTPS URLs on port 443.

test.failed: PayPal couldn't send a test webhook.
test.errorMessage:
PayPal couldn't send a test webhook:
{message}

disabled.title: Local development environment is on
disabled.summary: Payment changes only arrive with the hourly status sync. Turn it off in the {advancedTab} of a live shop.

noWebhook.title: No webhook received yet
noWebhook.summary: PayPal sends one when a payment changes. Webhooks from before the update to this version aren't recorded.

registration_missing.title: No webhook registered
registration_missing.summary: Payment changes only arrive with the hourly status sync. Register the webhook in the {advancedTab}.

registration_invalid.title: Webhook registered for another URL
registration_invalid.summary: PayPal sends the webhooks elsewhere, for example to a staging system or an old shop URL.
registration_invalid.description: Send a test webhook first, then register the right URL in the {advancedTab}.

registration_outdated.title: Webhook registered with an outdated token
registration_outdated.summary: PayPal has the right URL, but not the current token.
registration_outdated.description: Refresh the webhook in the {advancedTab} to register the current token.

registration_unknown.title: Registration couldn't be checked
registration_unknown.summary: PayPal couldn't be asked, for example because the API credentials in the General tab are missing or invalid.

last_webhook_failed.title: Last webhook failed
last_webhook_failed.summary: The shop couldn't process the webhook from {date}. The log below has the details.

unknown_transaction.title: Webhook for an unknown payment
unknown_transaction.summary: Usually another shop or a staging system uses the same PayPal credentials. Give each system its own credentials.

missed_events.title: Webhooks didn't arrive
missed_events.summary: {count} event since the last webhook: {eventType} on {date}. PayPal retries for 3 days. | {count} events since the last webhook, the newest {eventType} on {date}. PayPal retries for 3 days.

reachability.title: Reachability
reachability.description: Sends a test request to the URLs PayPal calls, like PayPal does. It runs from this server, so a pass means the URL answers here, not that PayPal gets through.

host_unresolved.title: Domain doesn't resolve
host_unresolved.description: DNS has no address for the domain, so PayPal can't reach it. Check the domain's DNS records.

host_local.title: Only reachable on this server
host_local.description: The domain resolves to an address of this server itself, like 127.0.0.1. PayPal can't reach it, even if the test request from this server gets through.

certificate_invalid.title: Certificate not accepted
certificate_invalid.description: The URL's TLS certificate isn't valid, for example self-signed, expired or issued for another domain. PayPal only calls URLs with a valid certificate.

redirected.title: Redirected
redirected.description: The URL redirects, and PayPal doesn't follow redirects. Common causes are a redirect to HTTPS or to the maintenance page.

denied.title: Access denied
denied.description: The URL asks for a login or blocks the request, for example through basic auth or a firewall. Allow PayPal's requests to this path.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.description: The URL doesn't reach the PayPal extension, for example because rewrite rules block the path.

server_error.title: Server error
server_error.description: The shop answered with a server error. The log has the details.

unexpected_answer.title: Unexpected answer
unexpected_answer.description: Something other than the PayPal extension answered, for example because the domain isn't assigned to this Sales Channel.

host_private.title: Resolves to a private address
host_private.description: The domain resolves to an address of a private network, which PayPal can't reach. Some servers resolve their own domain to their private address on purpose (split DNS). The internet then sees another address, and this is no problem.

timeout.title: No answer
timeout.description: The URL didn't answer within 5 seconds, PayPal's limit. Servers often can't reach their own public URL, so PayPal may still get through.

connection_failed.title: Connection failed
connection_failed.description: The connection to the URL failed, for example because a firewall drops it. Servers often can't reach their own public URL, so PayPal may still get through.

callback.warning: Callback URL may not be publicly reachable | Callback URLs may not be publicly reachable
callback.passed: Callback URL answers | Callback URLs answer
callback.description: Shipping cost updates may fail when PayPal can't reach the callback URL.

webhook.error: Webhook URL isn't publicly reachable | Webhook URLs aren't publicly reachable
webhook.warning: Webhook URL may not be publicly reachable | Webhook URLs may not be publicly reachable
webhook.passed: Webhook URL answers | Webhook URLs answer
webhook.description: Payment updates may not arrive when PayPal can't reach the webhook URL.

action.warning: Check that PayPal can reach the URLs from the internet, not only this server.

twig.title: Template overrides
twig.subtitle: Checks whether templates of themes, extensions and apps keep PayPal elements from showing in this Sales Channel.
twig.selectSalesChannel: Select a Sales Channel to check its templates.
twig.labelContainedBlocks: Contains PayPal block | Contains PayPal blocks

storefront.title: Storefront
storefront.notApplicable: Not checked, as this Sales Channel has no storefront.
storefront.noOverrides: No template keeps PayPal elements from showing in the storefront.

documents.title: Documents
documents.notApplicable: Not checked for this Sales Channel.
documents.noOverrides: No template keeps PayPal details from showing on documents.

missing_parent.title: {namespace} replaces PayPal elements
missing_parent.description: This template overrides a PayPal block, or a block around one, without calling parent(), so the PayPal elements don't show.

conditional_parent.title: Possible override in {namespace}
conditional_parent.description: This template overrides a PayPal block, or a block around one, and calls parent() only inside an if or for, so the PayPal elements may not show.

conditional_block.title: Possible override in {namespace}
conditional_block.description: This template overrides a block around a PayPal block and keeps the PayPal block only inside an if or for, so the PayPal elements may not show.

template_replaced.title: {namespace} replaces a PayPal template
template_replaced.description: This template doesn't extend the template it overrides, so it replaces it completely, including the PayPal elements.

plugin_template_skipped.title: {namespace} skips a PayPal template
plugin_template_skipped.description: This template uses extends instead of sw_extends, so it skips the PayPal template.

dynamic_extends.title: Can't check a template of {namespace}
dynamic_extends.description: This template extends a template named in a variable, so the check can't tell whether PayPal elements show.

unreadable.title: Can't read a template of {namespace}
unreadable.description: The template couldn't be parsed, for example because it extends a template that doesn't exist. This doesn't necessarily affect what's shown.
